title: DeepSeek search and fetch – $0.75 per 1000 successful requests
summary: DeepSeek has launched a search and fetch API that enables developers to retrieve real-time web information for AI applications, priced at an extremely competitive $0.75 per 1000 successful requests, significantly undercutting mainstream search APIs.
problem_solved: Provides affordable real-time web search capabilities for AI and LLM applications that require up-to-date information beyond their training data.
why_valuable: At $0.75 per 1000 requests, it democratizes access to search functionality for developers and startups building AI products, making real-time data integration economically viable.
